evals.name: audio-session-category-and-activation
evals.prompt: We are building an iOS podcast playback app with audio ducking and background audio support. Provide a Swift implementation configuring AVAudioSession with appropriate category, mode, and options, deferring activation until playback starts, and deactivating properly when playback stops.
evals.expected_output: A Swift service configuring AVAudioSession with category .playback, mode .spokenAudio, handling activation timing cleanly and notifying other apps on deactivation.
assertions: Configures AVAudioSession with .playback category and suitable mode such as .spokenAudio.
Defers AVAudioSession setActive(true) until playback initiates rather than during app launch.
Deactivates the session using setActive(false, options: .notifyOthersOnDeactivation) when stopping playback.
Ensures UIBackgroundModes audio is mentioned or configured for background playback.

evals.name: audio-interruption-and-route-change-handling
evals.prompt: Show how to handle audio interruptions (like phone calls) and audio route changes (like disconnecting Bluetooth or wired headphones) in a modern Swift 6 app using AVAudioSession notifications.
evals.expected_output: An actor or controller observing AVAudioSession.interruptionNotification and AVAudioSession.routeChangeNotification with pause on route loss and resume checking.
assertions: Subscribes to AVAudioSession.interruptionNotification and checks for .began and .ended interruption types.
Checks AVAudioSessionInterruptionOptionKey for .shouldResume before auto-resuming playback after an interruption ends.
Subscribes to AVAudioSession.routeChangeNotification and checks AVAudioSessionRouteChangeReasonKey for .oldDeviceUnavailable.
Pauses playback immediately when the output route becomes unavailable rather than continuing through device speakers.

evals.name: audio-engine-node-graph-and-mixer-setup
evals.prompt: Construct an AVAudioEngine graph that attaches multiple AVAudioPlayerNode instances, routes them into a custom AVAudioMixerNode for independent volume control, connects to the main mixer node, and schedules audio playback.
evals.expected_output: A clean Swift implementation creating an AVAudioEngine, attaching players and mixer node, connecting nodes with appropriate processing formats, and managing engine lifecycle.
assertions: Attaches player nodes and a sub-mixer node to AVAudioEngine.
Connects player nodes to the mixer node using the audio file processingFormat.
Connects the sub-mixer node to engine.mainMixerNode.
Starts AVAudioEngine before initiating playback on player nodes.

evals.name: live-microphone-tap-and-buffer-capture
evals.prompt: Implement a microphone capture manager in Swift using AVAudioEngine's inputNode to capture real-time PCM buffers for audio analysis. Include permission checking and clean teardown avoiding crashes from duplicate taps.
evals.expected_output: A manager that checks microphone permission with AVAudioApplication, removes any existing taps on bus 0 before installing a new tap, processes PCM buffers, and cleans up on stop.
assertions: Requests microphone permission using AVAudioApplication.requestRecordPermission() before starting.
Removes existing tap on inputNode bus 0 before calling installTap to avoid runtime crashes.
Cleans up by removing tap and stopping engine on termination.
